answer: Operational control reports 100% for operated subsidiaries, joint operations, JVs and associates and 0% for non-operated ventures. Financial control reports subsidiaries at 100% whether operated or non-operated, joint operations at Shell's share, and JVs/associates at 0%. The ESRS boundary reports subsidiaries at 100%; joint operations at 100% when operated and Shell's share when non-operated; and JVs/associates at 100% when operated and 0% when non-operated. Equity reporting uses Shell's ownership share. Scope 3 uses the equity boundary, including Shell's share of emissions from energy products sold, including products sourced from third parties.

evidence.quote: Shell reports Scope 3 emissions using an equity boundary.
Scope 3 emissions ... Boundary applied by Shell: Equity boundary
